evidence.source: Shuowen.org, received Shuowen entry for 医 with Duan Yucai commentary
evidence.field: definition; component analysis; sound note; received Guoyu quotation
evidence.text: The entry gives 医 the fanqie 於計切 and glosses it as a container for bows, crossbows, and arrows, analyzed as 从匸从矢. Duan calls that analysis associative; he reports that the small-Xu version adds 矢亦聲, a sound role for 矢. His commentary says the received Guoyu text has 翳 where the quotation has 医. This records competing historical interpretations; it does not independently confirm the pictured object or its ancient name and pronunciation.
evidence.title: 說文解字「医」 - 「說文解字」在線查詢

gaps: Official Unicode character-specific Unihan pages were not accessible in this session. Current reading pairs are supported by the provided exact local rows, not by inspected Unicode click-through pages.

The current Mandarin pair 矢 shǐ / 医 yī does not establish the small-Xu historical phonetic proposal. No exact Baxter–Sagart reading for 医 was provided, so the historical comparison remains unresolved.

The Shuowen gloss and small-Xu phonetic note are historical dictionary testimony, not independent evidence for the earliest form or pronunciation of the depicted container. Its original name and sound remain unrecovered.

The exact original SVG for 医-seal.svg could not be fetched by the web tool; its identity, source links, and stated reuse terms were verified on the exact Commons description page. The 醫 image's original link was available on its exact page.
No dated early artifact glyph or independently dated earliest medical or weapon-container use was established in this research pass; graphic development and semantic chronology remain unresolved.

items.caption: A modern seal-script-style rendering of 医. The received Shuowen account analyzes it as 匸 enclosing 矢 and glosses it as a weapon container; the form does not independently confirm that interpretation.
items.alt: A seal-script-style character 医 drawn with an arrow-like form inside an enclosure.
items.selection_reason: Useful illustration of the form discussed by the Shuowen account, with the caption separating the historical explanation from paleographic confirmation.

limitations.text: Both selected images are modern vector redrawings in Shuowen seal-script style, not dated artifact photographs. The exact 医 SVG request returned a cache miss, although its Commons description page established the candidate and stated rights. No inspected early artifact form resolves the earliest shape of 医 or 醫.
